title: Nalanda
tagline: Nalanda — The World’s Greatest Ancient University & UNESCO Mahavihara

overview.short: Nalanda Mahavihara is an iconic UNESCO World Heritage site and the most revered ancient residential university in history, flourishing from the 5th to the 12th century CE.
overview.description: Located 90 kilometers southeast of Patna, Nalanda was the ancient world’s pinnacle of higher learning, attracting over 10,000 scholars and 2,000 masters from across Asia, including China, Korea, Japan, Tibet, and Persia. Supported by the Gupta, Harsha, and Pala dynasties, the monumental red-brick complex spanned vast residential monasteries (viharas), multi-tiered stupas, meditation cells, and the legendary nine-storey library Dharmaganja. Today, the majestic archaeological ruins and the Xuanzang Memorial stand as enduring monuments to ancient India’s intellectual golden age.
overview.about: A profoundly historic center of learning where brick courtyards, ancient lecture halls, intricate stucco Buddha niches, and world-class museums narrate over 800 years of academic mastery.

howToReach.roadNote: Connected via NH-120 and NH-31 from Patna (85 km), Rajgir (15 km), and Bodh Gaya (80 km).

topPlaces.name: Nalanda Mahavihara Archaeological Ruins (UNESCO)
topPlaces.description: Vast red-brick excavation complex featuring 11 residential monasteries, 6 temples, stone wells, meditation cells, and ancient drainage systems.

image.alt: Nalanda Mahavihara Archaeological Ruins (UNESCO) in Nalanda, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Great Stupa of Sariputta (Temple Site 3)
topPlaces.description: Towering multi-layered brick monument built over the relics of Buddha’s foremost disciple Sariputta, adorned with 6th-century stucco panels of Buddha and Bodhisattvas.

image.alt: Great Stupa of Sariputta (Temple Site 3) in Nalanda, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Xuanzang (Hiuen Tsang) Memorial Hall
topPlaces.description: Grand Indo-Chinese pavilion built to commemorate Chinese pilgrim-scholar Xuanzang, who studied and taught at Nalanda in the 7th century CE.

image.alt: Xuanzang (Hiuen Tsang) Memorial Hall in Nalanda, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Nalanda Archaeological Museum
topPlaces.description: Four-gallery museum displaying over 13,000 excavated antiquities including Pala bronzes, terracotta seals with university insignia, stone sculptures, and charred rice grains.

image.alt: Nalanda Archaeological Museum in Nalanda, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Kundalpur Digambar Jain Temple
topPlaces.description: Revered Jain pilgrimage shrine believed to be the birthplace of Lord Mahavira by Digambar tradition, featuring a towering white marble temple and sacred lotus pond.

image.alt: Kundalpur Digambar Jain Temple in Nalanda, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Pawapuri Jal Mandir (Lotus Pond Shrine)
topPlaces.description: Breathtaking white marble temple situated in the center of an expansive lotus-filled water tank, marking the exact cremation and Nirvana spot of Lord Mahavira in 527 BCE.

image.alt: Pawapuri Jal Mandir (Lotus Pond Shrine) in Nalanda, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Surya Mandir (Sun Temple of Surajpur Baragaon)
topPlaces.description: Historic Sun temple located on the banks of Surajpur lake, hosting massive gatherings during the sacred Chhath Puja festival, featuring antique stone idols of Surya.

image.alt: Surya Mandir (Sun Temple of Surajpur Baragaon), Nalanda

topPlaces.name: Ghora Katora Eco Lake & Buddha Monolith
topPlaces.description: Pristine horse-hoof-shaped lake cradled between five scenic hills, home to a 70-foot pink sandstone statue of Buddha installed amidst the azure waters with pedal boating.

image.alt: Ghora Katora Eco Lake & Buddha Monolith in Nalanda, Bihar

faq.q: How far is Nalanda from Patna and Rajgir?
faq.a: Nalanda is 85 km (2 hrs drive) from Patna and just 15 km (20 mins drive) from Rajgir.

faq.q: What are the visiting hours for the Nalanda ruins?
faq.a: The ruins are open daily from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The nearby museum is open 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM and closed on Fridays.

faq.q: Are electric vehicle carts available at Nalanda?
faq.a: Yes, battery-operated carts are available at the entrance to transport senior citizens and families comfortably.
